thread:
IncidentBot: [PAGER] P1 - spike in 5xxs for tenant voyager (voyager-prod-vpc). Endpoint: /v1/generate. Error rate ~40% over 2m. Alert: https://alerts.redwood/alerts/ALRT-9832 :rotating_light:
Ben (on-call): ack, I'm on it. Pulling recent logs and pool metrics now.
Ben (on-call): seeing KV-cache OOMs and slot eviction churn on dedicated pool `voyager-pool-2`. 503s originate at runtime shard nodes 7-9.
Carla (ML Eng): thanks. This looks like the same cache thrash we saw after the quantization rollback yesterday. Quick mitigation: pin Voyager to the safe variant `gpt-rw-slim-v1-safe` and enable fallback routing to the coldpool while we stabilize.
Ben (on-call): plan: 1) apply tenant override -> pin to safe variant 2) route a % of traffic to coldpool for any failing shards 3) monitor error rate and latency 4) escalate if >5% 5xxs for 10m. Executing step 1 now.
Ben (on-call): running command: `redwoodctl override apply --tenant voyager --model gpt-rw-slim-v1-safe --duration 30m --reason "KV cache thrash"`
IncidentBot: override accepted. Change ID: OV-9921. Routing change initiated: voyager-prod-vpc -> safe-variant/coldpool.
Ben (on-call): errors dropping. 5xxs down to ~2.4% in the last 2m. Latency back near SLO (p50 210ms).
David (AE): looping in Voyager CS and their platform lead. Posting a short customer-facing note; will join the postmortem call. :phone:
Erin (Support): I'll post an incident update to the Voyager support channel and include the temporary mitigation and ETA. ETA for full recovery/check: 15m.
Carla (ML Eng): follow-up actions: - keep pin active for 24h while we run a targeted regression test; - capture KV cache metrics and request traces for the 7-9 shards; - check quantization kernel selection logs for recent change IDs. Filing INF ticket.
Ben (on-call): handing off monitoring to night on-call @Alice. Handoff summary: override OV-9921 active until 12:10 UTC, rollback plan in runbook https://runbooks.redwood/ov-9921-rollback, threshold: >5% 5xx sustained 10m => escalate to SRE lead. Ping me if anything spikes.
Alice (night-oncall): ack. Dashboard pinned, alert thresholds adjusted, I'll escalate if it crosses threshold.
IncidentBot: P1 -> P2 (customer impact reduced) per Ben. Created follow-up ticket INF-3241 (RCA + quantization rollback review).
Ben (on-call): quick note — recommend we add a temporary increase to KV cache size for voyager-pool-2 and schedule a safe-variant canary with 5% traffic before full rollout.
Carla (ML Eng): agreed. I'll open the canary rollout PR and include perf regressions to block merge.
David (AE): sending final customer update now: "We've applied a safe variant and routing fix; errors have dropped. We're monitoring closely and will follow up with RCA."
Erin (Support): posted update. Closing the live pager thread; monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
summary: Live mitigation for voyager VPC: on-call applied tenant override to pin safe model variant and reroute to coldpool; errors dropped from ~40% to ~2%; handoff to night on-call; follow-up RCA ticket created.
